info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Petadoption Pets Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status Retrieval API provides a streamlined way to access the current status of pets in the adoption program. Users can retrieve detailed information on available pets, their adoption status, and related metadata. This endpoint primarily serves pet adoption agencies, animal shelters, and organizations involved in pet rehoming. By querying this API, stakeholders can efficiently track pet availability and make informed decisions regarding adoption initiatives.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of pets by their status.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all pets filtered by their current status, which can be available, pending, or adopted. Use this operation to easily get updated information on pet availability.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of pets. It allows the client to specify parameters related to pet status, which can be utilized to filter the results returned by the API.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of pets.
